items.headline: December 9, 2025
items.text_head: December 9, 2025: The processing and publication of Commitments of Traders data were interrupted from October 1 – November 12 due to a lapse in federal appropriations. Following a return to normal operations, the CFTC resumed publication of the Commitments of Traders reports in chronological order. The release schedule depicts the intended COT Report publication dates for the data associated with the original publication date. Press Release: CFTC to Accelerate Publication of Backlogged COT Data

items.headline: November 18, 2025
items.text_head: November 18, 2025: The processing and publication of Commitments of Traders data were interrupted from October 1 – November 12 due to a lapse in federal appropriations. Following a return to normal operations, the CFTC will resume publication of the Commitments of Traders reports in chronological order. The release schedule depicts the intended COT Report publication dates for the data associated with the original publication date.  Press Release: CFTC to Resume Publishing COT Reports Wedne

items.headline: January 07, 2025
items.text_head: January 07, 2025:  Due to the National Day of Mourning for the passing of former President James Earl Carter Jr., CFTC offices will be closed on Thursday, January 9, 2025. This week’s Commitments of Traders Report will be released on Monday, January 13, 2025.

items.headline: November 13, 2024
items.text_head: November 13, 2024: As previously announced by MGEX October 3, 2024 Alert, Minneapolis Grain Exchange (MGEX) was renamed MIAX Futures Exchange (MIAX Futures). Therefore, weekly Commitments reports for the WHEAT-HRSpring would change to indicate MIAX rather than MGEX.

items.headline: May 5, 2023
items.text_head: May 5, 2023:  The respective Consolidated Reports combine their associated e-micro contracts S&P 500 (13874+), Nasdaq100 (20974+), DJIA (12460+)

items.headline: March 21, 2023
items.text_head: March 21, 2023: The cyber-related incident at ION prevented the submission of timely and accurate data to the CFTC last month. As a result, the weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders (CoT) report had been delayed. Today, staff is issuing the Commitments of Traders report that was originally scheduled to be published on March 17, 2023.

items.headline: March 17, 2023
items.text_head: March 17, 2023:  The cyber-related incident at ION prevented the submission of timely and accurate data to the CFTC last month. As a result, the weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders (CoT) report has been delayed. Today, staff will not issue the Commitments of Traders report as data for this week will need to be reviewed and validated. The CFTC intends to sequentially issue the missed COT reports, subject to reporting firms submitting accurate and complete data.

items.headline: February 16, 2023
items.text_head: February 16, 2023: Following the ION cyber-related incident, reporting firms are continuing to experience some issues submitting timely and accurate data to the CFTC. As a result, the weekly Commitments of Traders (CoT) report will be postponed. CFTC staff intends to resume publishing the CoT report as early as Friday, February 24, 2023. Press Release: CFTC Announces Postponement of Commitments of Traders Report

items.headline: February 10, 2023
items.text_head: February 10, 2023: The impact of the cyber-related incident at ION is being mitigated. However, multiple reporting firms continue to experience technical issues that prevent submission of timely and accurate data to the CFTC. As a result, the weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders report will continue to be delayed until the receipt and validation of all reportable data is completed. Press Release: CFTC Issues Statement on the Ongoing Impact to Reporting

items.headline: February 2, 2023
items.text_head: February 2, 2023: An ongoing issue with a third-party service provider is impacting some reporting firms’ ability to provide the Commission with timely and accurate data. As a result, the Commitments of Traders report for publication date February 3, 2023, will be delayed. A report will be published upon receipt and validation of data from those firms. CFTC Statement on ION and the Impact to the Derivatives Markets
